format: NDCA Sanctioned events, recognition of an event as a competition

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: At least two couples must participate in any featured event for it to be accepted as a bona-fide competition.

requirement: Before an NDCA profile is enabled, decide what 'featured event' covers and what DanceFlow does when fewer than two couples take part (recognition as a competition, not first-place treatment).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI.
interpretation_notes: Scope ambiguity preserved, NOT a source conflict: the sentence says 'any featured event' while III.D.8 speaks of 'events, single dance or multi dance'. Whether 'featured event' means every event or only some is not defined in the text read. This rule concerns minimum participation for the event to count as a competition; first-place treatment of an uncontested entry is the separate rule OD21-NDCA-0002. Studio's two-couple floor (OD21-DF-0001) is DanceFlow policy and is not this rule. Edition difference for III.D.6 vs the July 2026 edition is UNVERIFIED (not covered by PR 840).
decision_refs: OD-21 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve Studio/Custom minimum-participation and withdrawal rules for initial activation; retrospective audit PR #795)
